transcript.content: Hello. What brings you into the clinic today?

I came in because I can’t stop thinking it’s all my fault. My friend died, and I didn’t call her back when I should have. I had ugly thoughts sometimes too, and I keep telling people I’m the reason she died. I know the Lord is punishing everyone at my church because of me.
Along with these thoughts, have you been feeling persistently down, sad, or depressed lately?
I’m not sure. I mostly just can’t get past what I did—what I think I did.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in doing things that you usually enjoy?
Yes. I used to love choir, knitting circle, bingo, even walking through Patterson Park. Now I just sit in my chair. None of it feels worth getting dressed for.
Have you ever experienced a period like this before in your life, where you felt this way or lost interest in your usual activities?
I’m not sure. I can’t really think of another time quite like this.
Have you ever experienced these kinds of beliefs or unusual thoughts during a time when you were feeling completely fine and not depressed?
No. Before my friend died and I got so low, I never thought the choir or the pastor were sending me warnings. That only started these past weeks, after I felt so guilty.
